name: Línea Directa Aseguradora, S.A., Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros
summary: Línea Directa Aseguradora, S.A., Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros engages in insurance and reinsurance business in Spain and Portugal. The company operates through Automobiles, Home, Health, Other Insurance, and Other Activities segments. The Automobiles segment offers car, third party, motorcycle, theft, fire, and fleet insurance. The Home Insurance segment offers theft damage, civil liability, fire, aesthetic damage, and anti-squatting insurance. The Health Insurance segment provides health care products Vivaz brands.
